messages:
sophie: Anyone seen a blue Tupperware with a dinosaur sticker? Left it on the fridge this morning :sweat_smile:

mike: Noticed a mysterious container by the toaster earlier. looked very noble :thinking_face:

lola: is this the one with the suspicious lasagna aura? :eyes:

dave: If it's the lasagna one it's now officially part of the office relics. We must convene the Tupperware Tribunal.

jamie: Tupperware Tribunal agenda: 1) Identify owner 2) Offer beverage as penance 3) Determine if it can be microwaved (vote)

sophie: lol do we have a gavel or do we use the golden stapler? :rofl:

kitchen-bot: Reminder: Please label food left in the fridge. Unclaimed items will be added to the communal shelf after 48h. (rule id: `kitchen/label_v2`)

mike: Proposal: owner reacts with :dino: to reclaim, otherwise it goes to the communal snack pile :pizza:

lola: :dino:

dave: :shrug: (I keep one eye open when approaching the sacred container)

jamie: If no reaction by EOD, I will ceremonially appoint it to the office (and bring replacement Tupperware). :white_check_mark:

sophie: hah okay thanks y'all, found it — it was under a stack of mugs. Crisis averted. Tupperware Tribunal dismissed :pray: :tada:
